ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel coverage concentrated in linear and focal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe displays prominent high-contrast diagonal white linear bands. The right lobe displays a decentralized pattern of small, high-intensity circular spots and localized mid-tone grey mottling in the central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate aperture of 92 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary; the left lobe trailing edge features deeper pixel-valleys (higher amplitude) compared to the more frequent, lower-amplitude serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit convex curvature; trailing edges demonstrate a moderate concave sweep leading toward acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 40-50 small, roughly circular white pixel clusters (2-8 pixels in diameter) primarily distributed across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of 5-7 parallel diagonal high-intensity linear marks on the mid-to-outer left lobe surface; several shorter, intersecting white linear disruptions visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the left ventral surface; irregular notches and pixel-level interruptions along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pigmentation morphology between the left lobe (linear/striated) and the right lobe (punctate/mottled).
